items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Myra Johnson, bless her, she's my little buddy.

ctx.x: I say, 'I want to come in.' (Unintelligible)/ Yeah, how old are you? 18, sir. Now, wait now, and then Teddy Hill saw me and he said come on in here, man and (unintelligible) June Clark said yes, and I sit down and that waiter come over wiping the table, see those waiters can wipe those tables, you know, watching you. What kind of Coca Cola you want.

I said, Coca Cola so now -- Myra Johnson, bless her, she's my little buddy. She saw that man was getting ready to get me so she says, 'Come here, little fellow.' I say yes. She says 'Are you geechy?' and I said 'Yes, I'm geechy,' because people from New Orleans and South Carolina, they call each other geechys, so especially when you speak that patois, so now --
